name: action_control
description: Lets the player steer an entity with the actions move_x and move_y.

components.name: Controlled
components.description: The entity's Velocity follows the actions move_x and move_y, multiplied by speed. horizontal and vertical turn an axis off: the entity then leaves that part of its Velocity alone (a jumper steered left and right keeps vertical false, so gravity decides how it moves up and down).

systems.name: steer
systems.description: Sets the Velocity of every Controlled entity from the current move_x and move_y actions.
